propositions: AC items carrying operational-evidence markers (deploy, prod, live-run, IaC-apply, cloud-state, merge-gate, human-action, store-surgery, attestation) without [operator-attested] tag are not flagged at plan time, causing acceptance-verifier failures until retroactively tagged
A deterministic lexicon-based advisory lint (non-blocking, no LLM) should flag such untagged operational-evidence AC items at plan-review time to prevent round-trip failures
The lint must extend p6_ac_quality and keep DET_CHECKS at exactly 9 checks without adding routing entries or new P-levels to maintain structural stability
The plan-time lint and the completion-verifier must share a single _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE regex object to ensure consistent tag recognition by construction
The lint's lexicon must achieve ≥70% precision on a ≥50-item sampled flagged set and ≤5% flag rate over the frozen historical AC corpus, with recall measured against 31 known tagged items
Known past failures (tickets 115b and 8c4f) must fire on their historical tag-stripped AC text as unit-test fixtures to prove the lint catches real cases
